ideas.pitch: An AI-powered satellite monitoring and orbital debris collision forecasting platform leveraging Poisson regression and spatial mapping.
ideas.title: OrbitalGuard AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly matches the 'Where AI Meets the Final Frontier' space-inspired innovation theme of Graviton and utilizes rigorous forecasting inspired by past AI incident forecasting wins.

ideas.pitch: An aerospace supply chain risk detection and compliance investigation platform using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.title: AeroStream AML
ideas.why_it_could_win: Brings heavy-duty graph intelligence and compliance analytics to the aerospace and defense supply chain sector, aligning with CGC University judges' enterprise focus.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace with secure crypto-economic escrow payments tailored for decentralized space data and telemetry sharing.
ideas.title: CosmoEscrow Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge autonomous AI agents with decentralized escrow rails on Base, reproducing a proven hackathon-winning architecture in a space-tech context.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that transforms unstructured live telescope and drone feeds into searchable, queryable event logs.
ideas.title: AstroVision Video Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves the massive data ingestion bottleneck inherent in astronomy and space exploration, echoing the exact structural win of LibrAI.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven no-code algorithmic trading and strategy copying platform specialized in space economy assets and perpetuals.
ideas.title: NovaTrade Space-Perps
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts a grand prize-winning trading bot architecture specifically for emerging space market speculations, appealing to the entrepreneurial judges.
